subject: GCP renewal coordination: PO parity, split-term acceptance & tax evidence
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@healthsync.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal paperwork + split-term ask (GCP marketplace)

Hi Vivek / Kimberly,

We're kicking off our renewal for the GCP marketplace commitment and I'd like to align paperwork and invoicing ASAP. A few constraints from finance/procurement below: 

- HealthSync wants to mirror the private-offer economics (unit parity) but split acceptance into an 18mo primary term + 6mo top-up, due to budget cycles.
- We need a clear invoice lane so our AP team can split payments across two fiscal periods (Q1/Q3).
- Please confirm tax handling for our EU entity (VAT reverse charge vs supplier invoice).

Attached is our PO draft for reference (HealthSync_PO_Draft_2027.pdf). Can you confirm what documents Redwood will need, and whether you can provide an evidence bundle for tax/VAT? Also, a timeline for DocuSign and acceptance would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if easier.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Director, Procurement
HealthSync

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@healthsync.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + split-term ask (GCP marketplace)

Hi Lisa — thanks, and sent to the right people here. Short answer: we can support a split acceptance (18mo + 6mo) behind a single private offer, but we need to align on three things before DocuSign:

1) PO parity: confirm target unit price for the primary term + top-up (we should mirror the private-offer pricing exactly).
2) Invoice lanes: finance needs explicit invoice schedule & GL instructions (we'll provide an invoice schedule template).
3) Tax evidence: we need either a VAT registration cert or an S3 evidence bundle.

Next steps I propose (high level):
- I’ll work with Marissa to produce a private-offer package and draft amendment that maps the PO to the marketplace acceptance (target by Thu 12/3).
- Kimberly will confirm invoicing lanes and tax flow and request any additional billing fields your AP needs.
- We'll share a DocuSign link for the amendment + PO parity cover page once legal signs off.

If you can send the fiscal GL codes (for invoice split) and confirm VAT treatment for the EU entity by EOD Thu, we should be on track for a 12/15 execution.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@healthsync.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Private offer draft + proposed amendment (redlines attached)

Vivek / Lisa — attaching the private-offer draft and our proposed amendment that maps the PO to Marketplace acceptance. Key points I redlined:

- Add explicit clause for split acceptance timing and invoice schedule (section 2.1).
- Parity clause: private-offer unit price must be identical to Marketplace listed SKU price at signing; we've added a grandfathering sentence for any minor price changes prior to acceptance.
- Tax: added language requiring customer provide VAT docs or sign attest to reverse-charge where applicable.

Attachments: Redwood_PrivateOffer_Terms_v2.docx (redlines included).

Lisa — can your legal accept redlines or do you prefer we take a quick 15m loop with your counsel?

--
Marissa Cole
Sales Ops — Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@healthsync.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice lanes & tax evidence for HealthSync renewal

Hi Lisa — quick update from finance: we can produce split invoices tied to the two acceptance events. Requests from our side: 

- Please provide the GL codes and the vendor name exactly as your AP expects them. We will generate two invoices: one dated on the 18mo acceptance effective date, and one dated on the 6mo top-up effective date.
- For VAT: upload either your VAT certificate or a signed EU reverse-charge attestation to the S3 evidence bucket. I will create a manifest file that we will both reference in the DocuSign amendment.

S3 evidence location (read-only): s3://redwood-evidence/healthsync/renewal-2026/ (I’ll open a presigned link once we have the manifest entries).

Attachments: s3-evidence-bundle-manifest.txt (stub; contains required filenames).

Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations — Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@healthsync.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DocuSign timing & SOC2 snapshot request

Thanks all — we can provide GL codes and VAT cert by EOD Wed (12/9). Two quick asks from HealthSync: 

- Can Redwood include an option in DocuSign for the AP billing contact to be CC'd on invoices? That avoids manual forwarding.
- We also need a SOC2 snapshot and the most recent security summary for our compliance team before final signature.

If you can route the DocuSign link to my counsel (counsel@healthsync.com) and our AP (ap@healthsync.com), we'll process immediately.

Lisa

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@healthsync.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final: DocuSign route + evidence handoff (HealthSync renewal)

Lisa — appreciate the quick turnaround. Final confirmation and next steps: 

- DocuSign: I will send the amendment + cover page (PO parity table + invoice schedule) to counsel@healthsync.com and ap@healthsync.com by EOD Monday (12/14). We will include an optional CC field for the AP contact on the invoice notification.
- Evidence: Kimberly has staged the manifest; please upload the VAT cert to s3://redwood-evidence/healthsync/renewal-2026/ and reply to this thread once complete. We will generate presigned URLs for Redwoods’ legal + your counsel.
- SOC2: attaching the SOC2 snapshot link and a short security summary in DocuSign bundle (security snapshot available at https://redwood-secure.example.com/snapshots/soc2-2026-11).
- Execution target: 12/15 signature to keep the 12/1 renewal effective cadence; if legal needs more time we have a fallback to a 12/31 effective date and will enable capacity fallback routing to preserve throughput during the acceptance window.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link as promised.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
